notes: Chronos — a three-movement generative artwork exploring time's passage through particle systems, flow fields, and reaction-diffusion. Movement I (Genesis): organic particle birth with curl-noise flow fields. Movement II (Flux): Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion patterns with wave interference. Movement III (Entropy): crystalline decay spiraling to center. Seeded deterministic via URL hash (8-char hex). 40k-120k adaptive particles. Five curated palettes. Generative drone audio (Web Audio API). Fullscreen, 2x supersampled PNG export. Adaptive resolution for 60fps. Minimal fade-away UI. Keyboard: Space=pause, R=reseed, F=fullscreen, E=export, A=audio, H=hide UI, 1-5=palettes. Mouse/touch exerts force field. Tested in Chrome 120+: runs 60fps at 1440p on M1/M2, 45-60fps on integrated graphics. Known limitation: export re-simulates full timeline in offscreen context (10-30s), audio requires user gesture to unlock.
